title: Even affine moment from odd moments
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\mathrm{law}$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $c\in\mathbb R$. Suppose that for every natural number $j$ with $1\le j\le r$, $\mathbb E_{\mathrm{law}}[X^{2j-1}]=0$. Then $\mathbb E_{\mathrm{law}}[(1+cX)^{2r}]=\sum_{j=0}^{r}\binom{2r}{2j}c^{2j}\mathbb E_{\mathrm{law}}[X^{2j}]$.
